stories.title: World Series Game 5 Tonight — Brewers on the Brink
stories.angle: Game 5 tonight 7 PM CT at Tropicana Field — Brewers lead 3-1 but Rays forced Game 5 with walk-off in 12th; Cubs-fan rival-watch framing; Misiorowski starts

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
GAME 5. TONIGHT.

Only the fifth team EVER to force this from down 3-0 — Ben Williamson's walk-off in the 12th kept Tampa alive.

Brewers still lead 3-1. Misiorowski on the hill, 7 PM CT on FOX.

Jed Hoyer is watching.

stories.title: Michael King — The Opt-Out Clock

MICHAEL KING.

When the World Series ends — possibly TONIGHT — the 5-day opt-out window starts. Hoyer has to move fast.

3.00 ERA. 10-9. 4.1 bWAR in 2026. MLB's second-best SP on the market.

Go get him.

stories.title: Seiya Suzuki — Qualifying Offer Incoming
stories.angle: Cubs extending $23.15M QO; Suzuki declines to test market; Blue Jays at $130M+; career-best 5.1 WAR in 2026; formal farewell

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
FIVE SEASONS.

Cubs expected to extend Suzuki a $23.15M QO this week — a formality. He'll decline.

Career-best 5.1 WAR in 2026. The Blue Jays are ready to spend $130M+.

Chicago's best offer probably can't match. Take a bow, Seiya.

stories.title: Teruaki Sato — Cubs at the Table
stories.angle: NPB Triple Crown winner (.306/.383/.609, 39 HR) officially in posting system; Cubs scouted him since May; massive competition; 45-day window

x_posts.label: Post 5

THE NEXT TARGET.

Teruaki Sato — NPB Triple Crown winner (.306/.383/.609, 39 HR) — is in the posting system. Cubs have scouted him since May.

Yankees, Dodgers, Mets, Phillies all in. The market opens mid-November.

Hoyer better write a big check.
